full.label: Full method
full.hypothesis: Evidence gating, delayed qualification, and snapshot isolation together provide reliable evolution.

success_only.label: Success-only
success_only.hypothesis: Failure diagnostics are not useful for bottleneck discovery.

failure_as_positive.label: Failure-as-positive
failure_as_positive.hypothesis: Unresolved failure behavior should not directly become trusted capability.

immediate_promotion.label: Immediate promotion
immediate_promotion.hypothesis: Cross-task recurrence alone is insufficient for reliable deployment.

outcome_only.label: Outcome-only qualification
outcome_only.hypothesis: Explicit policy consumption is needed to attribute a successful reuse.

online_update.label: Online update
online_update.hypothesis: Same-batch exposure enables self-confirmation and increases false promotion.

strict_cross_task.label: Strict cross-task qualification
strict_cross_task.hypothesis: Same-task success can overestimate transfer reliability.
